page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top; page number 547 top right. Main text in one block of paragraphs, with a genealogical bracket diagram (tabula) set in the middle of the page between the first and second paragraphs. Marginal line numbers (5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35) run down the left margin. Signature "Mm 2" and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: Porrò Matthæus recensèt illos, ex quibus Christus ortus est secundùm carnem, vno Iosepho excepto: vt qui non fuerit naturalis pater Christi, sed putatiuus. Luca 3. verf.23. Lucas autem ita describit maiores Christi, vt Eli, qui 5penultimus est in istâ genealogiâ fit pater Iosephi legalis. Hîc in conspectu fit ista tabula.
main_text.l: Maria, soror matris Domini. Eius filij ex
Cleophas, maritus posterior Mariae, sororis matris Domini.
main_text.p: Porrò Matthæus recenset posteros Dauidis ex Salomone, Lucas ex Nathane. Et Christus quidem natus est ex Salomone iuxta promissionem Dei. 2.Sam.7.verf.12. & deinceps. Etsi enim regnum siue stirps regia defecit in Zedekiâ, vt patet suprà ex num.235: genus tamen Salomonis propagatum est per Iechoniam, qui genuit Sealthielem; Sealthiel verò genuit Pedaiam: Pedaia Serubabelem, qui 25non quidem rex, sed tamen dux populi Dei constitutus est à Cyro, & 30ἀρχ[?]ικὸν ἀξίωμα in stirpe Salomonis transmisit vsque ad Christum. Cæterùm quod dixi de patre Iosephi naturali & legali, hoc ita habet. Iacobus & Eli fuerunt fratres vterini, eiusdem matris, sed diuersorum patrum. Eli duâ vxore moritur sine liberis: Iacob huic ex lege Mosis semen excitauit: & è relictâ coniuge Eli suscitauit Iosephum, naturâ quidem filium suum, sed beneficio legis filium Eli.35

page.notes: The catchword reads "546.Ma-" in print; the page number in it is doubtful, so only "Ma-" is given as the catchword. The Greek word after "ἀρχ" is hard to read at this scan size; the first letters are marked [?]. The diagram boxes are read from the bracket layout; levels follow the depth of the brackets. Printed spellings (Sealthielem, Pedaiam, Serubabelem) are copied as they stand.
